verdict.rationale: Dover documents a REST API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The llms.txt file, Markdown copies of doc pages, and the MCP server are adjacent machine-readable features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
